keyFindings.description: A1 passes when meaning search never ran. Dispatch's runSearch answers a query with no tsquery node (a stopword-only query such as 'the') with {results: [], limit, offset} and no degraded field before it tries the embedder (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/search.go:412-419 on main; Degraded is omitempty, model/model.go:332). judgeA1 reads only the field's absence, so it answers {degraded:false, results:0, verdict:'pass'} for that answer (reproduced with bun -e at bc359229). An empty answer cannot show which path ran: judge it unavailable with a fixed category, fix the comment at :311, add a test, and re-run the production proof at the new head.

errorCategory reports every status other than 401/403/404 as 'transport'. A 400 refusal (a --pair query over contracts.SearchQueryMax, search.go 'q' cap) prints 'unavailable: transport' and sends the operator to the network. Add a fixed category for other 4xx refusals.

exitCode has no production caller: runChecks computes EXIT_CODE[overallVerdict(...)] inline, so the exitCode tests (test :520-532) test a copy. Make runChecks use the one function, or test the exit code through runChecks only; drop exports nothing imports.

The failed issue read and failed search are faked with HttpStatusError, which only readJson (healthz, coverage) throws; the live search and issue reads go through DispatchClient, which throws DispatchServiceError/DispatchGatewayError. Fake the error the live path throws.

Cleanup: checkPair tracks the issue side's outcome in shared, issueFailure, a nested issue variable and an empty catch, then rebuilds found at :375. One helper answering number | Category for the issue read plus lexer leaves two returns. Same output and categories.

Cleanup: runChecks' whole-body catch and the err dependency duplicate the import.meta.main catch (:645-654), which prints the same 'unavailable: <category>' with exit 2; A2's loop and summary and A3's printing sit inline where build and A1 have check* functions.
Cleanup: MalformedAnswer duplicates what the schemas do; readJson can return the text on a JSON parse failure, as DispatchClient does, and the schema parse reports 'malformed'.
The per-pair line format omits the 'A2 <KEY> unavailable: <category>' form printed when the pair's search itself is unavailable (meaning-search-check.ts:442).
